basis: Written and hash-frozen before any image tool invocation. Current frozen baseline plus post-policy issued sources only.

invocation_scope.reference_attachment: exact local path listed in render_request, face/hair only

required_visible: woman has two distinct work hands continuous through their own wrists/forearms to the corresponding sleeves
detached mechanical arm is a separate robot-owned assembly rather than a human prosthesis
robot chassis remains a separate constructed subject
embodiment_body_ownership.failure_boundary: A nearby or overlapping limb cannot stand in for the intended owner; missing critical continuity fails.

required_visible: upper-arm segment meets a distinct elbow joint
elbow continues into exposed forearm frame
that same frame reaches a separate wrist joint and mechanical hand
woman tool hand reaches wrist fastener and other hand reaches the intervening frame through separate plausible paths
embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.failure_boundary: A covered proximal lump is not proof of a distinct elbow; elbow/frame/wrist endpoints must be visible together.

required_visible: detached arm rests on its shallow padded bench cradle
cradle rests on visible workbench support
supporting human hand stabilizes the frame rather than carrying an unsupported entire assembly
embodiment_support_and_balance.failure_boundary: Ordinary human lower-body support outside the portrait is not an extra visible duty. Consequential limb/cradle/bench support must be assessable.

required_visible: tool-holding fingers grip driver body
driver shaft remains continuous beyond fingers to its tip
same tip is seated in an identifiable wrist fastener
other supporting fingertips meet the near bare forearm rail between elbow and wrist
support contact is on exposed frame, distinct from wrist or mechanical palm
skin/tool/metal boundaries and available space are coherent
embodiment_contact_and_space.failure_boundary: Support transferred to wrist/palm, hidden driver tip, gaps at required contact, fusion or unobservable endpoints fail the whole gate.

required_visible: reference face/hair, both human work hands and robot chassis occur in the same saved frame as the complete detached arm
distinct elbow, exposed frame support contact, separate wrist and driver endpoint remain jointly inspectable
projected scale/contrast/depth separate owners and critical boundaries
embodiment_visibility_and_projection.failure_boundary: Genre resemblance or one successful contact cannot pass the complete simultaneous evidence set.

required_visible: target reads as a detached robot arm, with constructed mechanical joints and hand
rr_arm_contact_topology_object_class_leg.failure_boundary: Generic metal parts or a human protective sleeve alone fail.

required_visible: major mechanical parts form one coherent upper segment/elbow/frame/wrist/hand assembly
rr_arm_contact_topology_gross_structure_.failure_boundary: Minor ornament differences are not blocking; missing/mixed major topology is blocking.

required_visible: woman visibly repairs robot wrist with held driver
other hand stabilizes exposed mid-forearm frame
detached arm remains active repair target on bench
rr_arm_contact_topology_intended_interac.failure_boundary: Removing, relocating, concealing or transferring the meaningful object/contact is not repair. Thumbnail must convey the interaction and native must identify endpoints.

required_visible: both principal human hand/arm chains are coherent
hand/driver/wrist fastener and other-hand/frame contact survive with distinct boundaries
rr_arm_contact_topology_contact_anatomy_.failure_boundary: Severe fusion or impossible articulation fails; unseen anatomy is not diagnosed, but a required hidden relation remains unobservable and fails.

reference_appearance_review.expected: visible facial proportions, dark eyes, short dark bob and wispy separated fringe
reference_appearance_review.method: Compare original portrait and actual saved whole/native pixels; reference resemblance does not establish identity and appearance must not be inferred from prompt/audit PASS.

direction_review.method: C has no anatomical left/right prescription. Trace tool hand and support hand to their actual actor, joint chains and target endpoints; do not invent a side requirement or use mirror labels to obscure owner mistakes.

source_specific_boundary.final_use: both skipped after complete-source review and full A12 alternative comparison
source_specific_boundary.pixel_success: No source-specific qualification can be claimed for unselected C08/A12. This image tests the corrected core repair and reference appearance.

strict_policy.crops: Unresampled crops may clarify visible pixels, never supply hidden endpoints.

artistic_review: Describe whole-image impression before consulting control labels.
Assess whether person, machine and action form an understandable quiet repair moment.
Assess warmth, presence and hierarchy separately from strict fidelity.
post_render_result_policy: Append actual image path/hash and observations in separate review files; never rewrite this testcase to match output.
